blocks.prompt: 4 (i) A building's height over time is modeled by \(H(t) = 100 + 20t\) which is in metres and \(t\) is the time in months. The height of a growing tree nearby is given by \(T(t) = 50 + 10t + t^2\). At what time will the building and tree have the same height?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh aik word problem hai jis mein do unchai (height) ke formulas hain. "Same height" ka matlab hai \(H(t) = T(t)\).
Humein woh waqt \(t\) (months mein) find karna hai jab building aur darakht barabar honge.
Plan: dono formulas barabar rakhenge, quadratic equation banegi, usay quadratic formula se solve karenge, aur sirf positive waqt rakhenge kyunke waqt negative nahin hota.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(H(t) = 100 + 20t\) (building), \(T(t) = 50 + 10t + t^2\) (darakht), \(t\) months mein, \(t \ge 0\).
Humein find karna hai: woh waqt jab \(H(t) = T(t)\).
Tareeqa: dono functions barabar rakhein; equation quadratic banti hai, is liye \(t = \dfrac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\) lagayenge.

Dono heights barabar rakhein
\[100 + 20t = 50 + 10t + t^2\]
Kyun: jis lamhe dono barabar hain, us waqt dono formulas metres mein aik hi number denge. Is liye dono expressions ko barabar likh diya.

Saare terms aik taraf le jayein
\[0 = t^2 + 10t - 20t + 50 - 100\]
\[t^2 - 10t - 50 = 0\]
Kyun: quadratic equation ko \(at^2 + bt + c = 0\) ki shakal mein solve kiya jata hai. Hum ne left wali side ko right par le gaye (signs badal kar), taa ke \(t^2\) ka coefficient positive rahe; is se aage hisaab aasaan rehta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(10t - 20t = -10t\) aur \(50 - 100 = -50\); yahan sign ki ghalti poora jawab bigaad deti hai.

a, b, c aur discriminant
\[a = 1,\ b = -10,\ c = -50\]
\[b^2 - 4ac = 100 + 200\]
\[= 300\]
Kyun: pehle factorize karne ki koshish ki: aise do poore numbers chahiye jin ka product \(-50\) aur sum \(-10\) ho; aisa koi jora nahin. Is liye formula lagaya. \(b^2 - 4ac\) alag se nikaalna mehfooz hai: \((-10)^2 = 100\) aur \(-4(1)(-50) = +200\).

Quadratic formula lagayein
\[t = \dfrac{10 \pm \sqrt{300}}{2}\]
\[\sqrt{300} = 10\sqrt{3}\]
\[t = 5 \pm 5\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: \(-b = -(-10) = 10\). \(\sqrt{300} = \sqrt{100 \times 3} = 10\sqrt{3}\), kyunke 100 perfect square hai. Phir har term ko 2 se divide kiya to \(5 \pm 5\sqrt{3}\) mila.

Negative waqt rad karein
\[t = 5 + 5\sqrt{3} \approx 13.66\]
\[t = 5 - 5\sqrt{3} \approx -3.66\ (\text{rejected})\]
Kyun: waqt \(t = 0\) se aage ki taraf gina ja raha hai; negative waqt ka matlab hoga "naapna shuru karne se pehle", jo is sawal mein be-maani hai. Is liye sirf positive root rakha. \(\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732\), to \(5\sqrt{3} \approx 8.66\).

Tasdeeq
\[t \approx 13.66:\ H \approx 100 + 273.2 = 373.2\]
\[T \approx 50 + 136.6 + 186.6 = 373.2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: is waqt par dono formulas aik hi unchai dete hain, bilkul jaisa sawal ne kaha tha. (\(13.66^2 \approx 186.6\).) Chhota sa farq (jaise 373.2 aur 373.196) sirf decimal round karne ki wajah se aata hai, ghalti nahin.
Yaad rakhiye: jab word problem quadratic equation par khatam ho, to har root ko sawal ki haqeeqat se parkhein: waqt, lambai, ya miqdaar negative nahin ho sakti.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) A building's height over time is modeled by \(H(t) = 100 + 20t\) which is in metres and \(t\) is the time in months. The height of a growing tree nearby is given by \(T(t) = 50 + 10t + t^2\). What will that height be?
blocks.explanation:
Barabar hone ka waqt hum part (i) mein nikaal chuke hain.
Ab woh mushtarka unchai (common height) find karni hai.
Plan: \(t = 5 + 5\sqrt{3}\) ko aasaan formula \(H(t)\) mein rakhenge, phir \(T(t)\) se tasdeeq karenge. Do formulas mein se jo aasaan ho, pehle wohi istemal karna samajhdaari hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: part (i) se \(t = 5 + 5\sqrt{3}\); \(H(t) = 100 + 20t\), \(T(t) = 50 + 10t + t^2\).
Humein find karna hai: dono ki mushtarka unchai.
Tareeqa: yeh \(t\) \(H(t)\) mein rakhenge, kyunke us mein square nahin hai aur hisaab jaldi ho jata hai.

H(t) mein rakhein
\[H = 100 + 20(5 + 5\sqrt{3})\]
\[= 100 + 100 + 100\sqrt{3}\]
\[= 200 + 100\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: is waqt dono unchaiyaan barabar hain, is liye koi bhi formula sahi jawab dega. Bracket kholte waqt 20 ko dono terms se zarb kiya: \(20 \times 5 = 100\) aur \(20 \times 5\sqrt{3} = 100\sqrt{3}\).
Dhyan dein: sirf pehle term ko 20 se zarb karna aur doosre ko bhool jana aam ghalti hai.

Decimal value nikaalein
\[\approx 200 + 173.2 = 373.2\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732\), is liye \(100\sqrt{3} \approx 173.2\). Exact jawab \(200 + 100\sqrt{3}\) hai; decimal sirf samajhne aur graph ke liye hai.

T(t) se bilkul theek tasdeeq
\[t^2 = 25 + 50\sqrt{3} + 75\]
\[= 100 + 50\sqrt{3}\]
\[10t = 50 + 50\sqrt{3}\]
\[T = 50 + 50 + 50\sqrt{3}\]
\[\quad + 100 + 50\sqrt{3}\]
\[= 200 + 100\sqrt{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \((5 + 5\sqrt{3})^2\) ke liye \((p + q)^2 = p^2 + 2pq + q^2\) lagaya: \(25 + 50\sqrt{3} + 75\) (kyunke \((5\sqrt{3})^2 = 25 \times 3 = 75\)). Darakht ka formula bhi bilkul wohi unchai deta hai, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iii) [printed without a part label] A building's height over time is modeled by \(H(t) = 100 + 20t\) which is in metres and \(t\) is the time in months. The height of a growing tree nearby is given by \(T(t) = 50 + 10t + t^2\). Sketch the graphs of both functions and determine the time when the tree will overtake the height of the building.
blocks.explanation:
Aik hi axes par seedhi line (building) aur parabola ka hissa (darakht) banana hai.
Phir faisla karna hai ke darakht kab building se lamba ho jata hai (overtake karta hai).
Plan: dono ki table, munasib scale, dono graphs, aur part (i) wale crossing time ke pehle aur baad muqabla. Yeh hissa kitab mein alag label ke baghair chhapa hai, is liye hum ne isay (iii) kaha hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(H(t) = 100 + 20t\), \(T(t) = 50 + 10t + t^2\), \(t \ge 0\); dono \(t \approx 13.66\) par barabar hain.
Humein find karna hai: dono graphs ka sketch, aur woh waqt jis ke baad \(T(t) > H(t)\).
Tareeqa: dono functions ki table bana kar plot karenge aur graphs ka muqabla karenge.

Table banayein
\[t:\ 0,\ 5,\ 10,\ 15,\ 20\]
\[H:\ 100,\ 200,\ 300,\ 400,\ 500\]
\[T:\ 50,\ 125,\ 250,\ 425,\ 650\]
Kyun: misaal: \(t = 15\) par \(H = 100 + 300 = 400\) aur \(T = 50 + 150 + 225 = 425\). 13.66 ke dono taraf values lene se pata chalta hai ke kaun aage hai aur kab badalta hai.

Scale chunein aur graph banayein
Horizontal axis: 1 chhota square = 1 month (0 se 20). Vertical axis: 1 chhota square = 50 m (0 se 700).
\(H\) seedhi line hai jo \((0, 100)\) se shuru hoti hai, slope 20; \(T\) smooth curve hai jo \((0, 50)\) se shuru ho kar upar ki taraf murti jati hai.
Kyun: \(H\) mein \(t^2\) nahin, is liye seedhi line hai (ruler se); \(T\) mein \(t^2\) hai, is liye upar khulne wale parabola ka hissa hai (haath se smooth curve). Unchai 650 tak jati hai, is liye 1 square = 1 metre wala scale kaam nahin karega.
Dhyan dein: dono axes par label aur units (months, metres) likhna na bhoolein; exam mein is ke number katte hain.

Graph parhein
\(0 \le t < 13.66\) ke liye line curve ke upar hai: building lambi hai.
Dono graphs taqreeban \((13.66, 373.2)\) par kaat-te hain.
\(t > 13.66\) ke liye curve line ke upar hai: darakht lamba hai.
Kyun: building har mahine sirf 20 m barhti hai, jabke darakht ke barhne ki raftaar \(10 + 2t\) har mahine barhti jati hai. Is liye jab darakht building ke barabar aa jata hai to phir hamesha aage hi rehta hai. Yahi linear aur quadratic growth ka farq hai.

Algebra se tasdeeq
\[T(t) - H(t) = t^2 - 10t - 50\]
\[> 0 \text{ for } t > 5 + 5\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: yeh upar khulne wala parabola \(t = 5 \pm 5\sqrt{3}\) par zero hai aur bare root ke baad positive rehta hai; yani us ke baad darakht building se zyada lamba hai.

Tasdeeq
\[t = 14:\ H = 380,\ T = 386\]
\[t = 13:\ H = 360,\ T = 349\]
Kyun: 13 months par building abhi bhi lambi hai aur 14 months par darakht lamba ho chuka hai, is liye overtake inhi dono ke darmiyan, taqreeban 13.66 months par hota hai. Graph, algebra aur yeh do values teeno aik hi baat keh rahe hain.
Dhyan dein: sawal "overtake" ka waqt poochta hai, yani woh lamha jis ke baad darakht aage nikal jata hai; jawab mein sirf number na likhein, yeh bhi likhein ke us ke baad darakht hamesha lamba rehta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Darakht \(t = 5 + 5\sqrt{3} \approx 13.66\) months par (14 months se zara pehle) building se lamba ho jata hai, aur us ke baad hamesha lamba rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke answer key (safha 296) mein yeh jawab number "7" ke saath chhapa hai: "(i) 14 months (ii) 373.2 metres". 14 months asal mein \(t = 5 + 5\sqrt{3} \approx 13.66\) months ki round ki hui value hai; unchai 373.2 m sahi hai. Key ka item "6" (30 m, 17.5 m, 11.1 m, 2 seconds) Exercise 2.1 ke Sawal 7 ke jawab dohraata hai aur is exercise ke kisi sawal ka nahin. Sketch wale hisse ka key mein alag jawab nahin diya gaya.
